tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyir bzlog drug gi khrid yig tshigs bcad ma zhugs/

na mo mañdzu nā tha ya/ ris med rdo rje'i gsang gsum dpa' bo ni/ /gzung 'dzin g.yem ma'i co 'dri nyid kyis kyang*/ /zung 'jug rtse dga'i dga' ston rgyas nas slar/ /rang bzhin bde ba'i khyim du ngal bsos shig /'dir ni bla ma'i man ngag zhig /dran pa'i snod du ci gnas pa/ /de tsam yi ger 'bri ba la/ /grub pa rnams kyis dgyes pa'i rigs/ /de phyir dam tshig mkhyen pa rnams/ /mnyes shing bzod par gyur na ni/ /thos pa tsam gyis mkhas rlom sogs/ khams gsum gshe bar gyur kyang sla/ /de la phyir bzlog rnam pa brgyad/ /phyi yi bar chad bzlog pa yi/ /bsam gtan 'khrul 'khor gzhan du bshad/ /'dir gang nges pa'i don bshad do/ /stag dang phag gi sgra dang ni/ /gtun shing dang ni mtshon cha'o/ /dgang dang dgug dang gzhol dang rengs/ /de ltar rlung gi rnal 'byor ro/ /stag gi sgra ni ha gsum dang*/ /hūṃ gsum ngag tu brjod par bya/ /pus mor lag bkab gru mo ni/ /rtsibs logs la brdeg phag skad 'byin/ /lag pas pus bkab lte 'og ni/ /g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab sdeb gtun shing*/ /mtshon cha rting g.yon bshang lam gtad/ /de mdun g.yas bzhags bol gnyis bzung*/ /g.yas g.yon dbus rngub rang phyogs bskor/ /bgang ba thub tshad rngub pa dang*/ /dgug pa mchil ma mid nas mnan/ /gzhil ba rngub chung byed pa dang*/ /rengs pa rtsol klod thad kar blta/ /sbyor ba bzhi la dor bzlas sbyor/ /rtsol med rdo rje'i bzlas pa'ang bya/ /lte snying lte la zla bar hūṃ/ /spyi bo nas ni rkang pa'i bar/ /gang ba bum can bsgom pa'o/ /rkang gnyis g.yas g.yon gsang bar srubs/ /kumbha ka yi bogs 'don no/ /rlung gi phyir bzlog go /dga' dang skyid dang dgra dang gdon/ /mya ngan nad dang mi snyan sogs/ / thams cad rang bzhin ma grub pas/ /mnyam pa nyid du blta bar bya/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir bzlog go /bde sdug ya nga ngo tsha dang*/ /nyon mongs gang skyes thams cad la/

/rang bzhin gsal stong me long blta/ /rang la gces 'dzin med par bya/ /lus ni sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul/ /gnod byed rnams la lus kyi sby-in/ /thams cad stong par shes par bya/ /de ni mnyam nyid ye shes so/ /'dod chags so sor rtog pa ste/ /phyag rgya bzhi la sbyor thabs yin/ /lta bar 'dod pa'i smra gtam dang*/ /dri ro reg dang gnyis sprod bzhi/ /reg dang bcug dang skyod dang mthar/ /lhan skyes phyi nang dga' bzhi por/ /rang rig gsal stong bsgom par bya/ /las rgya lan gcig myong byas nas/ /phyi nas myong pas bsgrub par bya/ /snying rje dang ni bya ba kun/ /rang bzhin stong pa gsal rig bsgom/ /bya ba grub pa de bzhin ste/ /mtha' bral sems la mtha' mi bsgom/ /ma bcos rang bzhin nyid las ni/ khro bo bde mchog gar mdzad pa/ /yid gyi rang bzhin stong par bsgom/ /rang bzhin med kyang nga rgyal ni/ /chos dbyings ye shes zhes bya'o/ /ye shes 'khor los phyir bzlog pa'o/ /dgra dang bgegs sogs gnod byed rnams/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma grub kyang*/ /las nyon gyis ni 'khor bar 'khor/ /de la snying rje drag tu bsgom/ /sems can kun la byang sems dang*/ /snying rjes bde sdug brje bar bya/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa la/ /gnod pa mi bya brtse bar bya/ /mi 'dod pa yis non pa'i tshe/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bsdu bar bya/ /snying rjes phyir bzlog pa'o/ /ci tsam gzung 'dzin snang ba kun/ / thams cad ye shes nyid du shes/ /gnyis 'dzin rgyun chags thams cad bya/ /'khrul pa thams cad skad cig tsam/ /rang rig skad cig 'gyur ba med/ / snang ba ci dang ci shar la/ /gsal tsam de la mnyam par bzhag /gsal stong tsam yang mi bsam dang*/ /bde sdug snang tsam la lta dang*/ /ngo bo med par dpyod pa gsum/ /'di yi gdams ngag yin zhes kyang*/ /rang rig skad cig gis phyir bzlog pa'o/ /rang sems gnod byed sems la thim/ /rang gzhan brje ba'i dmigs pa bya/

/lha sngags gnod byed la sogs pa/ /thams cad 'khrul pa shes par bya/ /'di nyid gnyis med ye shes la/ /kun rtog dra bas bcings nas ci/ /gnod bya gnon byed thams cad ni/ /sgyu ma'i dgra gnyen bzhin du blta/ /thob bya thob byed thams cad kyang*/ /rmi lam rgyal po'i rgyal srid bzhin/ /re dogs med par bsgom par bya/ /drod rtags gang la'ang dga' mi bya/ /gang la'ang ma zhen skyon mi lta/ /rang sems las gzhan sangs rgyas med/ /gnod bya gnod byed thob bya sogs/ /gang bsam rig stong ngang la bzhag /bdag bstod bsnyems 'khrig kun spangs so/ /legs pa thams cad bla ma'i drin/ /rkyen kun lha dang bla mar bsgom/ /yul dang spyod pa sna tshogs pas/ /nyams ni sna tshogs spros bral bsgom/ /srid zhi mnyam nyid kyis bzlog pa'o/ /lha sngags bla ma las 'bras brnyas mi bya/ /'jig rten mthun 'jug kun spangs smyon pa'i tshul/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin ye shes gnyis bral bsgom// // zhes pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa grub pa'i gsung bzhin rang lo nyer gnyis pa la bris pa'o/ /ma ṅga laṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 358 -- PAGE 359 -- PAGE 357 -
